title: callista uncata
intro: Callista uncata, commonly known as the "Wild Jasmine" or "Pigeon Orchid," is a flowering plant species native to tropical Asia, particularly in Sri Lanka and parts of India. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing stress and anxiety due to its calming effects, as well as its ability to promote better sleep quality and improve respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Callista uncata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Studies have shown that the bioactive compounds in Callista uncata may have therapeutic actions, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health.
